entries.04be902424cbbe25: This business operates discount stores and supermarkets in Hawaii and California in the United States. The main companies are Don Quijote (USA) Co., Ltd., Gelson's Markets, MARUKAI CORPORATION and QSI, Inc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥277,936 million (up 7.1% year on year), increasing due to new store openings in California, the consolidation of Mikuni Restaurant Group, Inc. as a subsidiary, and the effect of exchange rates. On the other hand, the destruction of stores by wildfires and the closure of unprofitable stores were factors that reduced revenue. Stores opened during the period were four in California, USA (TOKYO CENTRAL Irvine, TOKYO CENTRAL Emeryville, Gelson's Toluca Lake, and the sushi restaurant El Dorado Hills), and one store was closed.

entries.400ec05e65cfd7d3: This business operates "DON DON DONKI" stores in Asia, built on the concept of a Japan-brand specialty store. The main companies are Pan Pacific Retail Management(Singapore) Pte.Ltd. and Pan Pacific Retail Management(Hong Kong) Co.,Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥99,129 million (up 8.7% from the previous year). The company gives as the reasons for the increase in revenue that it reviewed the product mix (MD composition) in each area, launched new products, expanded assortments and strengthened product procurement using local distribution channels, which raised price competitiveness and increased the number of customers. In this fiscal year, 1 store opened in the Kingdom of Thailand (DON DON DONKI Central Westgate store), and 5 stores closed.

entries.d4535fa1b0554f6a: In Japan, this is the largest of the three reportable segments, operating the big convenience and discount store "Don Quijote," the family-oriented general discount stores "MEGA Don Quijote" and "MEGA Don Quijote UNY," and the general supermarkets "Apita" and "Piago." Don Quijote Co., Ltd., Nagasakiya Co., Ltd. and UD Retail Co., Ltd. operate "Don Quijote" and other stores in chain nationwide, and UNY Co., Ltd. runs a general retail business covering clothing, food, housing and leisure. In addition, Kanebi Foods Co., Ltd. handles retail of sushi, fried foods and prepared dishes and manufactures and sells lunch boxes for convenience stores; Pan Pacific International Financial Services Co., Ltd. and UCS Co., Ltd. handle credit card, electronic money and insurance agency businesses; and Acreative Co., Ltd. provides financial services including early purchase of accounts receivable. Nihon Asset Marketing Co., Ltd. leases and manages commercial properties for the group's discount store companies, and Nihon Shogyo Shisetsu Co., Ltd. leases and manages tenants in mixed-use commercial facilities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,068,195 million (up 9.1% year on year). The company cites as reasons for the revenue increase: the growth in customer numbers at existing stores from pricing strategies and sales promotions adapted to changes in customer behavior; strong sales of IP content products and trend products that appeal to customers' tastes; a rise in customers from Southeast Asia, Europe and the United States that brought tax-exempt sales to a record high; and 25 new store openings. The new food-focused format "Kyoraku no Denden Robin Hood" opened its first store in April 2026, and had five stores by June 2026. The number of domestic stores at the end of June 2026 was 676, and during the period four stores in Japan were closed. In the sales table, "other revenue" of ¥113,092 million (up 153.1% year on year) is included in the domestic business, in addition to the discount store and UNY businesses.
